name: EmberSign
subtitle: On-device signing and tweak injection
description: Development releases of EmberSign for iOS.

apps.name: EmberSign
apps.subtitle: Sign, customize, and manage IPAs
apps.localizedDescription: EmberSign signs imported IPAs using imported certificates and provisioning profiles, supports compatible tweak injection, imports and exports pairing records, and prepares development-signed apps for JIT through StikDebug or a configured SideJITServer. It does not provide direct Apple Account sign-in or create a fresh pairing record entirely on-device.

versions.localizedDescription: First development release with certificate and provisioning-profile signing, compatible tweak injection, pairing-record import and export, and JIT preparation with StikDebug or SideJITServer handoff.

apps.versionDescription: First development release with certificate and provisioning-profile signing, compatible tweak injection, pairing-record import and export, and JIT preparation with StikDebug or SideJITServer handoff.
